content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison script for NTHMP BM7 (Monai Valley tsunami runup, spherical run; header L1-24, Babak Tehranirad). Loads reference A.mat (L26; t, g5, g7, g9) and three model stations sta_0002/0003/0004 (L27-29). Scaling scaleT=10 (model time in 0.1-s units), scaleS=1 ('use cm' comment L32), lag=0.0 applied to measured time (L33-34). Model series tn1/g5n, tn2/g7n, tn3/g9n (L35-40). Three stacked subplots for gauges 5, 7, 9 (L44-76): measured solid vs model red dashed, axis [0 24 -2 5], ylabel cm, titles 'Gauge 5/7/9', xlabel Time(sec) on the last, legend 'Measured data'/'Numerical Simulation' Best (L76). No writes.
entities: script variables: data1 @L27, data2 @L28, data3 @L29, scaleT @L31, scaleS @L32, lag @L33, t (from A.mat, shifted @L34), tn1 @L35, g5n @L36, tn2 @L37, g7n @L38, tn3 @L39, g9n @L40; g5,g7,g9 from A.mat @L26

equations.ref: model time rescale (tn2 L37, tn3 L39)
model elevation, scaleS=1 keeps cm (g7n L38, g9n L40)

calls: clear all @L25; load @L26, @L27-29; clf @L42; subplot @L44, @L56, @L67; plot @L45, @L47, @L57, @L59, @L68, @L70; hold on @L46, @L58, @L69; axis @L48, @L60, @L72; title @L49, @L61, @L71; ylabel @L50, @L62, @L74; grid on @L51, @L63, @L75; xlabel @L73; legend @L76

verbatim_spans.text: %    results for maximum  runup of a monai valley.(Written by Babak Tehranirad)

unresolved: Station sta_0001 is skipped; sta_0002/0003/0004 map to gauges 5/7/9 -- mapping implicit, defined by the benchmark's gauge file only.
scaleS=1 with ylabel 'cm' assumes the model station output is already in cm (consistent with the spherical blowup convention); scaleT=10 again implies 0.1-s time units.
Header (L13-14) mentions uploading 'g7.txt','g9.txt' but data come from A.mat; the duplicated first-column description (L16-21) is template boilerplate.
